_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: work_todos_occurrence_key
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX work_todos_occurrence_key ON work_todos (series_id, occurrence_key)

data.name: work_todos_occurrence_index

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "provider_configurations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "product" TEXT NOT NULL, "region" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "disable_thinking" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("disable_thinking" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "credential_ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credential_cleanup" ("reference" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("reference"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_profiles" ("singleton_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "local_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "nickname" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_todos" ("series_id" TEXT NULL, "occurrence_key" TEXT NULL, "occurrence_index" INTEGER NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_todo_series" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspace_operations" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "undo_of" TEXT NULL, "receipt" TEXT NOT NULL, "changes" TEXT NOT NULL, "committed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_data_tables" ("type_id" TEXT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)), "schema_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_data_rows" ("table_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_table_types" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_preference_rows" ("singleton_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_run_rows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_request" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("session_id", "input_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "agent_run_events" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id", "sequence"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_conversations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_turns" ("input_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "history_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "agent_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("agent_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "undone_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("input_id"), UNIQUE ("session_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_job_rows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "unique_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "max_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lease_epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lease_owner" TEXT NULL, "lease_expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "lease_started_at" INTEGER NULL, "outcome" TEXT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_attempts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "job_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lease_epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "cancelled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("cancelled" IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE ("job_id", "lease_epoch"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "table_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "model_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_memories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_message_id" TEXT NULL, "source_session_id" TEXT NULL, "source_record_id" TEXT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_memory_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("paused" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX work_todos_occurrence_key ON work_todos (series_id, occurrence_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX work_todos_occurrence_index ON work_todos (series_id, occurrence_index)
CREATE INDEX work_todos_category ON work_todos (category_id, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX work_todos_due ON work_todos (status, due_at, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX work_categories_parent ON work_categories (parent_id, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX work_data_tables_type ON work_data_tables (type_id, deleted_at)
CREATE INDEX work_data_rows_table ON work_data_rows (table_id, deleted_at)
